About.Title: About
About.Bio: Marcus Amps-Woodward is a sports photographer with an eye for the action and the stories around it. Explore the portfolio, or get in touch to talk about your next event.
About.Heading: A feel for the moment.
About.StoryBody: Every sport has a rhythm. The build-up, the burst of effort, the reaction afterwards. Those are the moments worth keeping.
